parameters.prompt: The exact upright boar warrior in the reference stands in place, then is struck by an invisible blow: it flinches once with the head and upper body jerking back, then recovers and returns to the exact original standing pose and holds it for a moment. Then it is struck again and dies: the knees buckle, it drops to its knees and then falls forward flat onto the ground face down, and it lies completely still until the end. Keep the same three-quarter left view, boar head, tusks, fur and clothing. Exactly two arms and two legs. No walking, turning around, rolling over, thrashing, second flinch, blood, wounds, weapon. It stays at the same spot and size and does not move across the frame. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole character stays inside the frame with wide margins at all times. Do not change any colours or tint. No motion blur, motion trails, afterimages, speed lines, smears, glow, energy, coloured light, liquid, spray, projectile, particles, dust, rocks, cracks, shockwave, rings, shadow or text.

result.reviewNote: 通过：受击14–33头胸后仰回正；死亡86–108跪倒前扑脸朝下，108起静止。
